# `dashboard/views/permissions.ts`

## Overview

Provides view-layer rendering functions for the permissions management UI. Exports utilities for generating the full permissions administration page as well as a standalone permissions matrix table, which can be used independently as an HTMX partial for partial page updates.

---

## Interfaces

### `UserInfo`

Represents a user record as consumed by the permissions views.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Unique identifier for the user. |
| `displayName` | `string` | Human-readable display name for the user. |
| `role` | `string` | Role assigned to the user. |
| `dailyBudget` | `string \| null` | The user's daily budget limit, or `null` if unset. |
| `maxConcurrent` | `number \| null` | Maximum number of concurrent operations allowed, or `null` if unset. |

---

### `RepoInfo`

Represents a repository record as consumed by the permissions views.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Unique identifier for the repository. |
| `fullName` | `string` | Full repository name (e.g. `owner/repo`). |

---

## Functions

### `permissionsPage`

```ts
import { permissionsPage } from 'dashboard/views/permissions'
```

Renders the full permissions page containing a user × repository checkbox matrix. Returns a complete HTML string suitable for a full-page response.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | `UserInfo[]` | ✅ | List of users to display as rows in the matrix. |
| `repos` | `RepoInfo[]` | ✅ | List of repositories to display as columns in the matrix. |
| `grants` | `Set<string>` | ✅ | Set of active permission grant keys representing user–repo pairs. |
| `currentUser` | `SessionUser` | ✅ | The currently authenticated session user, used for context-aware rendering. |
| `globalMaxPerUser` | `number` | ❌ | Optional global cap on the number of repositories a user may be granted access to. |

#### Returns

`string` — A fully rendered HTML string for the permissions page.

#### Example

```ts
import { permissionsPage } from 'dashboard/views/permissions'

const html = permissionsPage(
  users,
  repos,
  new Set(['1:42', '2:42']),
  currentUser,
  10
)

res.send(html)
```

---

### `permissionsMatrix`

```ts
import { permissionsMatrix } from 'dashboard/views/permissions'
```

Renders only the permissions matrix table. Can be used as a standalone HTMX partial to update the matrix section of the page without a full reload.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | `UserInfo[]` | ✅ | List of users to display as rows in the matrix. |
| `repos` | `RepoInfo[]` | ✅ | List of repositories to display as columns in the matrix. |
| `grants` | `Set<string>` | ✅ | Set of active permission grant keys representing user–repo pairs. |
| `globalMaxPerUser` | `number` | ❌ | Optional global cap on the number of repositories a user may be granted access to. |

#### Returns

`string` — A rendered HTML string for the permissions matrix table fragment.

#### Example

```ts
import { permissionsMatrix } from 'dashboard/views/permissions'

// Return only the matrix fragment for an HTMX request
const fragment = permissionsMatrix(
  users,
  repos,
  new Set(['1:42', '2:42']),
  10
)

res.send(fragment)
```
